svg.title: Using a scale stencil on a tan forearm in five pictures. 1: sponge a teal, blue and purple base and let it dry. 2: lay the plastic stencil flat and hold it down with two fingers so it cannot move. 3: dab dark purple through the holes with a nearly dry sponge, working from the edges in. 4: lift the stencil straight up, without sliding it. Done: crisp dark scales over the soft base, with a few white highlights on the scales.
